name: 詹話字
objective:
本課程為大一學生所設計，旨在介紹美學與藝術史的基礎概念，並培養學生的觀察能力、視覺分析技巧與脈絡理解。課程不僅探討為何要學習美學與藝術史，也將引導學生如何觀察、分析與詮釋藝術作品。課程將探討美學思想如何影響我們觀看、理解與評論藝術作品，並引導學生將藝術作品置於不同的歷史、文化與社會背景中加以詮釋。透過作品觀察、文本閱讀、課堂討論、美術館參訪與小組討論，學生將學習分析藝術作品的形式、內容與意義，並嘗試將美學思考與藝術史知識應用於當代策展與文化創意實踐之中。

This course is designed for first-year students and introduces the fundamental concepts of aesthetics and art history. It focuses not only on why aesthetics and art history matter, but also on how to observe, analyze, and interpret artworks. Students will explore how aesthetic ideas shape the ways we see, interpret, and evaluate artworks across different historical, cultural, and social contexts. Through close looking, readings, class discussions, museum visits, and group projects, students will develop skills in analyzing form, content, and meaning, and will be encouraged to apply aesthetic thinking and art historical knowledge to contemporary curatorial, cultural, and creative practices.
schedule:
Week 1 (2/23)
Course Introduction: What Are Aesthetics and Art History? Why and How Do We Study Them?

Week 2 (3/2)
Ancient Greece & Rome: Ideal Bodies, Proportion, and Artistic Representation

Week 3 (3/9)
Medieval Art: Symbolism, Religious Imagery, and Spiritual Meaning

Week 4 (3/16)
Renaissance I: Humanism, Perspective, and the Emergence of the Artist

Week 5 (3/23)
Renaissance II & Baroque: Emotion, Power, and Visual Persuasion

Week 6 (3/30)
17th–18th Century Dutch Art: Everyday Life, Taste, and Global Trade

Week 7 (4/6)
No Class – Tomb Sweeping Day

Week 8 (4/13)
The Birth of Modernity: Photography, Impressionism, Post-Impressionism & Japonisme

Week 9 (4/20)
Museum Visit: Museum of Contemporary Art, Taipei

Week 10 (4/27)
Midterm Assignment

Week 11 (5/4)
Abstract & Cubist Art: Breaking Representation and Exploring Form

Week 12 (5/11)
Minimalist & Conceptual Art: Redefining Art beyond Objects

Week 13 (5/18)
Performance & Body Art: Art as Action, Identity, and Experience

Week 14 (5/25)
Surrealism, Participation, and the Unconscious

Week 15 (6/1)
Museum Visit: Taipei Fine Arts Museum

Week 16 (6/8)
Global & Contemporary Art: Art as a System—Institutions, Curating, and Publics

Week 17 (6/15)
Final Group Project Workshop and Presentation Preparation

Week 18 (6/22)
Final Group Presentations and Written Report Submission
scorePolicy:
Attendance and Discussions: 30%
Midterm Assessment: Individual written report on selected cases: 30%
Final Assessment: Group presentation, report, and course reflection: 40%
